# Intent-Traceable Design System - Visual Direction

## 1. Project Overview
- **Project name**: Intent-Traceable Design System (Intent-Driven Design System)
- **Type**: Fintech + Neon-Gradient Branding System
- **One-line intent**: Color is a strong neon and gradient tone, typography is magazine headline impact, and layout is a fintech-grade grid.
- **References analyzed**: 3 (ref-001, ref-002, ref-003)

## 2. Overall Direction

A system that combines financial technology (fintech) credibility with the high energy of neon gradients. **ref-001**'s bold display typography delivers magazine impact, **ref-003**'s neon-glow and mesh gradient color palette adds a modern electronic-device sensibility, and **ref-002**'s 12-column fintech grid firmly supports the information structure. Every token is designed to be traceable back to which reference it came from and why it was chosen.

## 3. Visual Direction Tags
- **Genre**: FinTech, Digital Product  
- **Style**: Neon-Glow, Geometric, High-Contrast  
- **Visual subject**: Neon Magenta (#FF1744) Primary Color, Dynamic Gradient Backgrounds, Bold Geometric Typography

## 4. Tone & Mood

- **Primary Color Dominance**: ref-003's Neon Magenta (#FF1744) is the center of every CTA and emphasis element. Its high saturation conveys both credibility and energy.  
- **Gradient Layering**: ref-003's 135° linear gradient (Magenta to Violet to Electric Blue) repeats as the dynamic background of backgrounds, hero sections, and emphasis areas. The radial cyan glow serves as a soft highlight.  
- **Dark Canvas**: On the Ink Dark (#1A1A1A) background common to ref-001 and ref-003, the neon colors are maximized. Meeting the AAA luminance standard guarantees accessibility.  
- **Display Typography**: ref-001's Bricolage Grotesque Bold (800) plus extremely tight tracking (-0.04em) gives magazine headlines an influential presence. The clamp() function keeps the impact on both responsive and small devices.  
- **Fintech Grid Foundation**: ref-002's 12-column grid (24px gap, 1280px max-width) aligns all data, cards, and form elements. It strengthens the information credibility of a financial dashboard.  
- **Neon-to-Neutral Dialogue**: The contrast between high-saturation neon (magenta, cyan, electric blue) and neutrals (ink dark, surface light) creates a perfect balance of legibility and energy.

## 5. Implementation Guidelines

- **Color Role Enforcement** (mode=system): primary is neon magenta only, secondary is electric blue, accent is cyan glow, neutral is ink dark / surface light. No role overlap.  
- **Typography Hierarchy**: h1 (display, 64-120px) -> h2 (heading, 36-56px) -> body1 (16px) -> caption (12px). Bricolage Grotesque is for headlines only, IBM Plex Sans is for body only. No mixing.  
- **Gradient Usage**: linear-gradient(135deg, ...) for the fullscreen hero, data section backgrounds, and emphasis overlays. Radial cyan glow for secondary decoration and interaction hover states.  
- **Grid & Container**: All content aligns within the 12-col grid. A consistent 24px gap. A maximum width of 1280px. The hero section uses a 16:9 ratio to optimize the gradient background.  
- **Spacing Scale**: xs (4px) -> sm (8px) -> md (16px) -> lg (24px) -> xl (32px). Button padding uses md, cards use lg, and sections use xl to tune the visual breathing room.  
- **Rounded Consistency**: sm (4px) for buttons and inputs, md (8px) for cards and modals, lg (16px) for layout elements. Maintains geometric sharpness.

## 6. Elements to Avoid

- **Washed-out Colors**: The high saturation of the neon palette is essential. Desaturated or pastel tones weaken the system's energy.  
- **Typography Mixing**: No mixed use of Bricolage (headlines) and IBM Plex (body). Each role must be kept distinct.  
- **Low-Contrast Combinations**: No light surface on light background, no dark ink on dark background. An AAA-standard luminance difference must be secured.  
- **Gradient Overuse**: No simultaneous gradient on both background and text. It reduces legibility. Apply the gradient to the background only, or only to accent element borders.  
- **Breaking Grid**: No departure from the 12-col grid, 24px gap, or 1280px max-width. This is the foundation of fintech credibility.  
- **Orphaned Icons/Graphics**: All secondary elements (icon, divider, shape) are unified through the color palette (primary/secondary/accent/neutral). No arbitrary new colors.
